label: Private language
resolution: STMT-PLA-REDUCTIO-READING takes the false sense and STMT-PLA-NONSENSE-READING the nonsense sense; they are rival readings and no record passes from one to the other. On either, the bearing on the candidate floor item F5 (STMT-COGITO-THOUGHT-OCCURS) is the same: the sections deny a private ostensive criterion of identification (§258), not that a thought occurs (§§304, 308). These remain full-strength competing interpretations of the text, not an exhaustive object-level semantic classification or mechanically checked negation pair. Their relationship is now an interpretive attacks annotation; refuting the nonsense interpretation alone does not prove that the text argues by reductio. A scoped incompatibility would need a fixed passage, content/meaning criterion and argument-strategy mapping; no such source judgment is manufactured. See docs/notes/semantic-rival-scope.md.
